name: Crazy Egg
summary: Website optimization with heatmaps, scroll maps, session recordings and A/B testing — see how visitors behave and lift conversions with data.
best_for: lean marketing teams that want heatmaps, recordings and built-in A/B testing in one consolidated tool — noting that testing starts on the $99 Plus plan, not the $29 Starter
skip_if: you want generous recordings, automatic heatmaps and qualitative feedback — Hotjar's free tier and product depth suit product teams better
honest_knock: The entry plan is thin on recordings — 50 a month against Hotjar's far more generous free tier. And A/B testing is not in it at all: that starts on Plus at $99, which jumps straight to 150,000 pageviews. Heatmaps need manual per-page setup and annual-only billing locks you in. Like all these tools it's diagnostic — it shows what's broken, it doesn't fix it. Worth knowing before you treat a result as banked: Crazy Egg states it can run A/B tests “after implementing just a small code snippet directly on the website”, which means a winning variant is served by that snippet rather than written into your pages. Stop paying and the original page is what visitors get. Move the winner into your own templates once a test settles.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed annually (5,000 pageviews, 50 recordings)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-10 on crazyegg.com/pricing, in a browser and by plain fetch, both showing the same ladder) Four plans, all billed annually, each with a 30-day free trial and, in the vendor's words, no overages, ever. Starter is $29 a month: 5,000 tracked pageviews, 5 heatmap reports and 50 recordings a month, with 6 months of recordings storage. Plus is $99 a month: 150,000 pageviews, 75 heatmap reports, 1,000 recordings, 2 years of storage, and unlimited A/B testing, CTAs and error tracking, with A/B targeting by device type. Pro is $249 a month: 500,000 pageviews, 100 heatmap reports, 5,000 recordings, targeting by device, country, UTMs and conversions, and export of heatmaps and recordings to AI. Enterprise is $599 a month: 1,000,000 pageviews, 200 heatmap reports, 10,000 recordings, targeting by all audience segments and SAML single sign-on. Every plan includes unlimited website domains, unlimited team members, web analytics, conversion tracking and surveys. More heatmaps or recordings are sold as add-ons through sales, with no price printed. A Free plan, no card required, covers web analytics, instant heatmaps, conversion analytics and surveys. Historical: on 21 August 2026 the pricing page we read showed a different three-plan ladder, Analytics from $29 and Growth from $99 on pageview sliders plus a quoted Enterprise, while the vendor's pricing.md already listed Starter, Plus, Pro and Enterprise at $29, $99, $249 and $599.
